verdict.rationale: Meltano documents scheduled pipelines orchestrated through Apache Airflow, which is an external tool. It also offers `meltano run` for executing EL(T) pipelines and claims to run all pipelines, including dbt workflows, in one place. Nothing in the evidence shows a native way to declare dependencies between steps or datasets and have Meltano resolve the run order itself, so dependency-aware ordering relies on Airflow. Missing for 10: native step/dataset dependency declaration, documented run ordering based on dependencies, dataset-level lineage triggers, independent corroboration.
